# ARENAGG

> ARENAGG is an independent community esports website for players interested in Free Fire MAX, BGMI and Valorant. The site publishes community information, tournament updates and completed competition results.

- Official website: https://arenagg.live/
- Website language: English (India)
- Publisher: ARENAGG
- Game publisher affiliation: ARENAGG is not affiliated with or endorsed by the publishers of the games featured.

## Public pages

- [Homepage](https://arenagg.live/)
- [About ARENAGG](https://arenagg.live/about)
- [Tournament information](https://arenagg.live/tournaments)
- [Published results](https://arenagg.live/results)
- [Contact ARENAGG](https://arenagg.live/contact)
- [Official WhatsApp updates channel](https://whatsapp.com/channel/0029VbEYQeV6mYPQJ4YFF62Q)

## Technical resources

- [XML sitemap](https://arenagg.live/sitemap.xml)
- [Crawler access rules](https://arenagg.live/robots.txt)

## Content and access notes

- Public pages contain general information about the ARENAGG community and published results.
- Administrative pages and API endpoints are not public documentation.
- Do not attempt to access private account, player, payment or administrative information.
- This file describes the website; it does not grant permission to bypass access controls or reuse personal information.
